title: next up
def: breakout: next season BPM 2+ over his established level (higher of BPM shrunk to -2, k 600, and 3-season Marcel) with 1000+ MP; base 2025-26; odds = logistic on shrunk BPM, ln MP + age curve, low-volume efficiency, shooting luck, projection gap, usage scaling (each passes leave-one-season-out 1990-2026, final t 11.41, 36/36 seasons). tiers: next-season TS+ and TOV% at that usage from players whose usage changed, shot profile (2P%+, FT%+, FTr, 3PAr) sets how fast efficiency falls; PTS/36 = 2 x TS x (1 - TOV%) x USG x plays; dim = a usage jump beyond 9 points (1 in 600 player-seasons)

cols.t: signals pushing his odds up most
